results.title: NATO tests future technologies to connect the battlefield
results.description:
Synopsis
 Russia’s war against Ukraine has shown how increasingly affordable drones, electronic warfare and connected technologies are changing the battlefield. To keep pace, Allied forces need interoperability: equipment from different countries and manufacturers working together as one. For nearly ... eed to know military operations. And sometimes that’s not a single person that has expertise in both of those fields and so we bring the innovators and we bring the Allied operators into conditions like this to collaborate, to exchange ideas and find those dual-use capabilities.”
